purpose: Map each official property-record retrieval to the precise facts it may establish and to the canonical property propositions it can support.

facts: official search result for the requested register scope
entries identified within the search scope
does_not_alone_establish: legal effect of every underlying instrument

facts: recorded deed/search result within the requested scope
does_not_alone_establish: complete legal effect of the deed

integration_chain: OFFICIAL_RECORD -> RETRIEVAL_EVENT -> DOCUMENT -> EXTRACTED_FACT -> VERIFIED_EVIDENCE -> CANONICAL_PROPOSITION -> LEGAL_EFFECT -> ANSWER
guardrails: A record may support some propositions without proving every proposition.
Historical records retain their date and applicable legal version.
No public answer may claim official retrieval without a corresponding retrieval event and evidence record.
